instantiated_cells.justification: Section 91000 makes knowing or willful violations of the title (which includes lobbying disclosure provisions in Chapter 6) a misdemeanor with fines up to $10,000 or three times the amount unreported, and §91005.5 authorizes civil penalties up to $5,000 per violation, establishing statutory penalties for lobbying disclosure violations.

unscoreable_emissions.reason: The bundled statute text (Chapter 11 enforcement, Chapter 6 lobbyist registration/reporting, and select Chapter 2 definitions) contains no provision addressing regular audits of lobbying disclosure records; any audit authority would lie in Chapter 3 (FPPC powers, §83100 et seq.) or a separate auditing statute not included in the bundle.
